notes.title: 🎶 Save & Sound participation announcement
notes.content:
Greetings!

Exclusive audio deep dive for Escape from Ever After releasing November 4th!

We’re happy to announce that Escape from Ever After will be at Save & Sound starting November 4th!

Save & Sound is an online music festival with sales and demos on Steam. Come celebrate headbanging soundtracks as well as unique implementations of music and audio in games.

We’ll be participating in the festival with an audio deep dive.

You can watch the showcase on Bedtime Digital Games’ channels:  
 Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg 
 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BedtimeDG

We’re excited to share some good music and good times with you. Check out the new trailer for Save & Sound 2024 below!

[previewyoutube=Kud112cK49c;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you enjoy the festival and see you when it goes live November 4th!

notes.title: ✨ Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is OUT ✨
notes.content:
Greetings!

Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is OUT! Play Now!

If you enjoy the demo (and we hope you will), please leave a review on Steam - it is extremely important for the platform’s internal algorithms and will ensure that more people will get to see and play the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649549/a701ddb69d0b00e13522911445b14570f6a75b21.png

Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is a free, standalone version of Escape from Ever After, featuring the game’s first chapter. It’s fairytales vs. capitalism in this adventure RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games!

Thank you and enjoy the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993656/dfc6e9df06f48bec0bd0d3c6c6673412ff3bae04.png

notes.title: Play Escape from Ever After: Onboarding July 19th!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We’re excited to announce that the prologue of our game, Escape from Ever After: Onboarding, will be available for free starting July 19th!

In this self-contained chapter from the game’s early story, you’ll start your internship with Ever After Inc.™ and travel into a twisted version of The Three Little Pigs, where the Three Pigs are bulldozing the forest to make room for their housing developments of straw, sticks, and brick.

And we have a special opportunity for our international fans! We are releasing in 8 languages:

 German
 French
 Japanese
 Korean
 Brazilian
 Portuguese
 Simplified Chinese
 Spanish
 Russian

We’re looking for speakers of these languages to play early and help us verify the quality of the translation! If you want to help, please sign up using this form: https://forms.gle/pbPehce1jzSv8VeQ6

Check out our latest trailer for Escape from Ever After: Onboarding:
